items.name: Decoder
items.summary: A low-level interface for reading JSON data from a byte stream

methods.name: decode
methods.signature: fn decode(&mut self, buf: &[u8]) -> Result<usize, ArrowError>
methods.summary: Read JSON objects from `buf`, returning the number of bytes read

methods.name: flush
methods.summary: Flushes the currently buffered data to a [`RecordBatch`]

methods.name: has_partial_record
methods.summary: True if the decoder is currently part way through decoding a record.

methods.name: is_empty
methods.summary: True if there are no records to flush, i.e. [`Self::len`] is zero.

methods.name: len
methods.summary: The number of unflushed records, including the partially decoded record (if any).

methods.name: serialize
methods.signature: fn serialize<S: Serialize>(&mut self, rows: &[S]) -> Result<(), ArrowError>

items.name: DecoderContext
items.summary: Context for decoder creation, containing configuration.

methods.name: coerce_primitive
methods.summary: Returns whether to coerce primitive types (e.g., number to string)

methods.name: ignore_type_conflicts
methods.summary: Returns whether to treat columns with incompatible types as missing (i.e. NULL)

methods.name: strict_mode
methods.summary: Returns whether to validate struct fields strictly

methods.name: struct_mode
methods.summary: Returns how to decode struct fields

items.name: Reader
items.summary: Reads JSON data with a known schema directly into arrow [`RecordBatch`]

methods.name: build
methods.signature: fn build<R: BufRead>(self, reader: R) -> Result<Reader<R>, ArrowError>

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Create a new [`ReaderBuilder`] with the provided [`SchemaRef`]

methods.name: new_with_field
methods.summary: Create a new [`ReaderBuilder`] that will parse JSON values of `field.data_type()`

methods.name: with_batch_size
methods.summary: Sets the batch size in rows to read

methods.name: with_coerce_primitive
methods.summary: Sets if the decoder should coerce primitive values (bool and number) into string when the Schema's column is Utf8 or LargeUtf8.

methods.name: with_ignore_type_conflicts
methods.summary: Sets whether the decoder should produce NULL instead of returning an error if it encounters value that can not be parsed into the specified column type.

methods.name: with_strict_mode
methods.summary: Sets if the decoder should return an error if it encounters a column not present in `schema`. If `struct_mode` is `ListOnly` the value of `strict_mode` is effectively `true`. It is required for all fields of the struct to be in the list: w…

methods.name: with_struct_mode
methods.summary: Set the [`StructMode`] for the reader, which determines whether structs can be decoded from JSON as objects or lists. For more details refer to the enum documentation. Default is to use `ObjectOnly`.
